$comment: Our schema of a compiled ARM template, the top-level skeleton Azure Resource Manager reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download.
description: Our schema of a compiled ARM template, an inner contract (ADR-REPO-CONTRACT-CONTRACTASSET): the skeleton Azure Resource Manager reads, kept local so an editor and a gate need no download. source: https://schema.management.azure.com/schemas/2019-04-01/deploymentTemplate.json (the full schema, 186 KB, refs hundreds of per-API-version resource schemas and uses oneOf/anyOf/allOf, outside the bounded subset of ContractSchema), trimmed to the top-level shape. Only the top-level sections are checked, never a resource body. Every compiled template is bound to it by contract.yml's applies_to. Taken 2026-10-17.
